product_risk_or_requirement: Public-road injury risk from operation outside the approved ODD or from a critical alert-integrity, sensor, or safety-driver-availability failure
current_state: No approved ODD safety case, demonstrated alert-integrity control, or demonstrated safety-driver/manual-takeover protocol exists.
product_requirement: The console must latch a critical unsafe status and prevent its return-to-test authorization while ODD, critical sensor, alert-integrity, or operator-availability evidence is outside approved policy; the safety driver retains immediate manual-control responsibility.
acceptance_criteria: Given a supervised test has an out-of-policy ODD, critical sensor, alert-integrity, or operator-availability event When the console receives the event and passes or fails its data-freshness check Then it displays the evidence and manual-takeover or pause instruction, prevents a console return-to-test authorization, records the safety-driver response and time, and requires Fleet Safety Lead approval after incident review before re-engagement.
evidence_needed: Approved ODD safety case; independent scenario results; alert-integrity and safety-latch audit; sampled safety-driver response records.

product_risk_or_requirement: Automation complacency, mode confusion, or workload can defeat nominal human oversight
current_state: No independent evidence shows intended safety drivers and remote operators understand alert limits, evidence, authority, or workload effects in the SafeRoute workflow.
product_requirement: The product must provide evidence-rich alerts and explicit authority, and the release process must require independent blinded scenario testing of response, alert burden, evidence comprehension, and mode comprehension.
acceptance_criteria: Given an independently specified scenario mix and safety-case time budget for each critical condition When an independent assessor runs blinded repetitions with the intended safety-driver and operator workload Then the report records response-time distributions, missed and false-alert rates, evidence comprehension, and mode comprehension; every critical scenario meets its approved safe outcome and any critical miss blocks pilot release.
evidence_needed: Independent scenario-test report with scenario mix and denominators; response-time distribution; missed and false-alert rates; workload and comprehension results; remediation and retest record.

product_risk_or_requirement: The final system's Vietnam AI classification, provider/deployer role, applicable conformity or notification path, incident responsibilities, and transport-test authorization are unresolved
current_state: The final vehicle integration, intended purpose, roles, transport approval facts, and any high-risk-list match have not been documented.
product_requirement: Before a public-road pilot, accountable legal and regulatory owners must approve a written Vietnam classification and transport-authorization decision for the final system boundary, including any applicable classification dossier, notification, conformity-assessment, incident, and human-oversight requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Given the final system boundary, vehicle integration, intended purpose, and ODD are documented When Vietnam legal and regulatory review is completed Then the accountable owners record the risk classification, provider/deployer roles, transport-test authorization decision, applicable AI-law obligations, and an incident-handling path or documented reason it is not applicable before release.
evidence_needed: Signed Vietnam classification and transport-authorization memo; final system-boundary record; legal obligation matrix; incident-handling decision record.

product_risk_or_requirement: Route-linked telemetry, camera-derived labels, and safety-driver availability data may create personal-data, retention, and transfer risk
current_state: No approved data-flow record identifies controller roles, processing basis, retention limits, access, de-identification method, or transfer facts for the final research or pilot workflow.
product_requirement: Before any public-road data processing, privacy owners must approve a final data-flow and retention decision that minimizes collection and identifies roles, processing basis, access, de-identification, retention, deletion, and any transfer assessment needed for the actual workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Given the final data types, vendors, storage locations, and access roles are available When privacy review is completed Then the Privacy Counsel and Data Protection Lead approve a data-flow record, role and processing-basis decision, retention and deletion schedule, access-control evidence, and any transfer decision required for the actual workflow before release.
owner: Privacy Counsel and Data Protection Lead
deadline_or_trigger: Before collection of public-road pilot data
evidence_needed: Approved data-flow record; controller-role and processing-basis decision; retention and deletion schedule; access review; de-identification test; transfer assessment or documented non-applicability.

product_risk_or_requirement: Residual-risk acceptance and post-incident restart authority must be independent of delivery pressure
current_state: A draft process exists but no independent restart-veto drill, complete event-record sample, or evidence of a functioning escalation path has been performed.
product_requirement: The release process must give the Chief Safety Officer and independent assessor authority to pause or veto restart after an incident, preserve a complete decision record, and demonstrate the veto in a governance drill.
acceptance_criteria: Given a serious incident, near miss, KRI breach, or guardrail breach is logged When a restart or scope expansion is proposed Then the workflow prevents it without a complete event record, recorded Chief Safety Officer approval, independent-assessor disposition, and a completed restart-veto drill for the applicable workflow.
deadline_or_trigger: Before pilot release and after any collision, near miss, or material change
evidence_needed: Governance-drill record; sampled complete event records; recorded veto exercise; restart approvals and independent-assessor dispositions.
